name: Advanced Micro Devices
tagline: Number two in AI chips, gaining while Nvidia is distracted.
strengths: Competitive AI GPUs and strong CPUs
weaknesses: Still far behind on software ecosystem
Valuation already prices in big share gains
thesis: Best-placed second source for AI accelerators
Data-center CPUs keep taking share from Intel
moat: Moderate: engineering scale and x86 position, but no lock-in comparable to CUDA.
outlook: Momentum is real, but after a huge run the shares need flawless AI execution. A good company at a full price.
news: Fell nearly 6% earlier this week, then roughly flat on Nov 17. Talked about heavily on X and Reddit.
changeMind: Pullback toward a lower multiple with AI GPU revenue on track would make it a Buy

sources.title: Trefis: What is behind AMD's nearly 6% slide?

method: Quick screen, not a full analysis: moat, red flags, headline ratios and relative valuation.
